items.title: Internal hom from a finitely presented module into a qc module is lqc-fbc and has the tensor adjoint
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter stacks-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Stacks)

items.difficulty_reason: The agreement of the two internal homs follows from the presheaf-level construction (fppf sheaf by the internal-hom lemma); lqc from the lqc-colimits lemma; fbc from part (6) of the check-flat-comparison lemma (F of finite presentation); the universal property is the Q-adjunction composed with the internal-hom-tensor adjunction.
